subject: Introduction to Applied Psychology
text: Describe Maslow’s Need Hierarchy Theory. Illustrate how the theory applies to a real-life situation, and examine how the different levels of needs influence human behavior in that context. 2.   Answer the following:(Attempt Any 2 Questions) A. List and explain the individual approaches to stress management. B. Explain the concepts of job involvement and organizational commitment, and illustrate with examples how each influences employee behavior at work C. Explain how emotions and moods influence negotiation and employee selection. Demonstrate this impact using relevant examples and examine the impact of these influences on organizational effectiveness. 3. Read the case and answer the following:. Read the case and answer the questions given below: At Technova Solutions, Neha, one of the youngest women in the team, consistently delivers strong results but is often overlooked for leadership roles, as colleagues assume she may not be assertive enough. Rajesh, who is nearing retirement, is often considered less capable of learning new tools even before his work is reviewed. Meanwhile, Karan, a fresh male recruit straight out of college, made a strong impression in his very first project, and since then his manager assumes all his coding work must be excellent, even though his later performance is only average. Anita, a female project manager, once made a mistake in a client presentation and since then her manager undervalues all her contributions, despite her otherwise strong record.

subject: Introduction to Applied Psychology
text: Identify and analyze the impact of perception errors influencing judgments about Neha ,Rajesh, Karan and Anita.

subject: Introduction to Applied Psychology
text: Evaluate the impact of these errors on employees in the organization and propose strategies that Technova could create to reduce such errors in perception.
